title: Magnetic speed formula
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as v = (qBd sin φ) / m.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as E = (q d B² sin³ φ cos φ) / m.

title: Entry distance from O
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must be expressed as L = d / (2 tan φ).

title: Magnetic force centripetal
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion, qvB = mv²/R, and correctly relate the radius R to the given distance d and angle φ.

title: Electric kinematics setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly decompose the velocity at point A into horizontal and vertical components and apply kinematic equations (d = v₀t, v sin φ = at) for motion in the electric field.

title: Link acceleration to E-field
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use Newton's second law in the electric field, qE = ma, to connect the kinematic acceleration to the electric field strength.

title: Geometric radius relation
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly state or use the geometric relationship for the circular arc's radius, R = d sin φ.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the sign of the charge in the force equations or misidentifies the direction of the electric or magnetic force.

title: Velocity component mix-up
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses the horizontal (v cos φ) and vertical (v sin φ) velocity components at point A in the kinematic equations.
